proposition: Running a PG is a platformer you keep losing to the same five obstacles, until you enter the one cheat code that makes you untouchable: install the RentOK app.

board.style_line: Original 2D side-scrolling pixel-art platformer, 16-bit era look, crisp oversized pixels, flat colours, hard-edged sprites, an Indian small-town PG lane as the level, vertical 9:16 frame, the game world filling the frame with a thin dark HUD band at the very top holding three pixel hearts on the left.
board.negative_line: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no Nintendo characters, no Mario, no mushrooms, no question-mark blocks, no turtles, no real brand marks, no blurry or soft pixels, no photoreal rendering, no faces of real people.

identity_anchors.owner: a stout pixel-art man in his forties, thick black moustache, cream half-sleeve kurta over dark brown trousers, brown chappals, a ring of keys on his belt, big round eyes, big-head sprite proportions about 32 pixels tall
identity_anchors.pg_lane: a side-scrolling street of three-storey pastel PG buildings with barred windows, rooftop water tanks, tangled overhead wires, a flat solid blue #0038FF ground strip the sprites run on, warm orange evening sky
identity_anchors.phone: a pixel-art smartphone item with a solid blue #0038FF body and a bright glowing cyan #03FFF1 screen, hovering and bobbing like a power-up pickup
identity_anchors.ok_blaster: a chunky pixel-art hand blaster in bright cyan #03FFF1 with a white barrel ring, held in the owner's right hand, firing round cyan bolts shaped like tick marks; when the owner holds it his whole sprite has a thin cyan outline glow

hero_frame.description: Mid-run, low angle: the owner sprite in full stride on the blue ground, cyan-outlined, ok_blaster raised and firing a fat cyan tick-bolt to the right; ahead of him the shadow-tenant obstacle is already crumbling into cyan pixels while two more obstacles wait further right, small and dim; the three HUD hearts are full again. Everything says immune and winning: power in the hand, obstacles dissolving, brand blue under his feet and brand cyan in his fist, with no word on screen.

audio.music_bed: Original upbeat 8-bit-style chiptune loop in a bright major key, 120 bpm, code-stitched under the whole film; drops to a single low pulse for beats 6-7 and returns doubled in energy from beat 8; no melody that quotes any existing game

beats.title: Spawn
beats.feeling: Instant recognition: this is a platformer, and the little guy is one of us, a PG owner.
beats.framing: Full level view, owner sprite standing at frame-left on the blue ground, pg_lane buildings behind him, three full hearts in the HUD; a small pixel key ring jingles at his belt; the camera is static, the owner blinks and bounces in an idle animation, a pixel crow crosses the sky.
beats.first_frame: Owner sprite at left, idle stance, feet on the blue ground strip, three full pixel hearts top-left, warm evening sky, a pastel PG building with a rooftop tank directly behind him, nothing moving yet.
beats.impact: Static camera, a two-frame idle bounce, one chiptune start-up arpeggio as the music bed kicks in; the hold is short so the thumb does not move on.

beats.title: Obstacle: the unknown tenant
beats.feeling: The first little sting: who is this person, really?
beats.framing: Side-scroll begins left-to-right; a grey shadow-figure tenant with a blank white rectangle where its face should be, holding a blank pixel ID card, stands in the owner's path; the owner runs into it, bounces back, one heart in the HUD flickers and empties.
beats.first_frame: Owner mid-run at left third, the shadow-tenant with blank ID card standing centre-right on the blue ground, three full hearts still in the HUD.
beats.impact: Continuous side-scroll, a hard bump-back on contact with a hit-flash on the owner sprite, a chiptune 'hurt' blip; the label super drops in on the beat.

beats.title: Obstacle: coins that run away
beats.feeling: Chasing money that will not sit still.
beats.framing: Owner runs right; three pixel coins float above the ground but each hops away as he jumps for it, the last one bouncing off-screen right; he lands empty-handed and a coin counter would show nothing (no counter is drawn); the owner's shoulders drop in a two-frame sulk.
beats.first_frame: Owner crouched to jump at left-centre, three gold pixel coins hanging in a row ahead of him at head height, blue ground, a barred PG window behind.
beats.impact: Rhythmic jump-miss-jump-miss, coins ping away with a descending chiptune blip each; short comic hold on the sulk.

beats.title: Obstacle: the midnight exit
beats.feeling: The gut-drop of an empty room and an unpaid month.
beats.framing: A pixel tenant with a suitcase sprints across the frame right-to-left past the owner and off-screen; behind him a PG door slams and swings open again on an empty room; the owner skids, turns his head after the runner, a second heart empties.
beats.first_frame: Owner running right at centre, a tenant sprite with a big suitcase caught mid-sprint at right edge heading left, a pastel door open behind them on the ground floor, two full hearts and one empty in the HUD.
beats.impact: Fast crossing motion against the scroll direction, door-slam sound, a low chiptune 'lose' tone; the owner's skid gives a half-second of stillness before the label.

beats.title: Obstacle: the paper avalanche
beats.feeling: Buried under registers nobody can add up.
beats.framing: From the top of the frame a stack of pixel ledger books and loose receipts tumble like falling blocks and pile on the owner until only his moustache and one hand stick out; a pixel calculator lands on top and its screen shows only a blank flicker.
beats.first_frame: Owner standing centre looking up, the first three ledger books already in the air above him, a stack of grey paper piles on the ground to the right, two hearts left in the HUD.
beats.impact: Falling-block physics, each ledger thuds with a chiptune clunk; the pile-up freezes for a beat with the hand poking out; the label super lands on the freeze.

beats.title: Obstacle: the complaint swarm and near game-over
beats.feeling: Overwhelmed; this is the point where you would put the controller down.
beats.framing: The owner crawls out of the paper as a swarm of small angry pixel sprites descends: a dripping tap, a broken ceiling fan, a flickering bulb, a leaking bucket, all with cross faces; they circle him, the last heart empties, the owner drops to his knees and the whole game world dims to near-dark with only the HUD and the owner's outline visible.
beats.first_frame: Owner half out of the ledger pile at centre, four small angry appliance sprites hovering in an arc above him, one full heart left in the HUD.
beats.impact: The swarm buzzes in fast, then the screen dims and the music bed collapses to a single slow low pulse; a long hold on the kneeling owner in the dark is the tension the cheat code will break.

beats.title: The cheat code
beats.feeling: The grin of someone who just found the secret that changes the game.
beats.framing: In the dim world a pixel strip like a cheat-code entry bar appears above the owner (drawn as an empty dark rectangle with a blinking cursor block, the text itself is code-composed); as the code completes, the phone item drops from the top of the frame, bounces once on the blue ground and hovers in front of the kneeling owner, its cyan screen the only bright light; the owner reaches out and touches it.
beats.first_frame: Dim game world, owner kneeling at centre, an empty dark rectangular input bar with a single blinking light block above his head, HUD hearts all empty.
beats.impact: Cheat-code letters are composed by code one at a time with a keyclick each; on the last letter a rising chiptune chime, the phone drops with a bounce sound and the cyan glow lifts the darkness around the owner; hold on the touch.

beats.title: Power-up: the ok_blaster
beats.feeling: Immunity. The tables have turned and it feels great.
beats.framing: White flash; the world snaps back to full colour brighter than before, the three HUD hearts refill with a cyan sparkle, the owner rises with the ok_blaster in his right hand and a thin cyan outline glow around his whole sprite; he pumps the blaster once and fires a fat cyan tick-bolt to the right which hits the shadow-tenant obstacle re-entering from frame-right and bursts it into cyan pixels; low camera angle, side-scroll resumes at double speed.
beats.first_frame: Owner rising to his feet at centre in full colour, ok_blaster in his right hand, cyan outline glow on his sprite, three hearts refilled in cyan, the shadow-tenant obstacle just entering at the right edge.
beats.impact: Flash-to-colour transition, hearts refill with a triple chime, the music bed returns doubled; the first shot is held for two frames of muzzle flash before the obstacle bursts; this is the hero frame, the film sells here with no words.

beats.title: Clearing the lane, part one
beats.feeling: Effortless. Every old problem now goes down in one hit.
beats.framing: Fast side-scroll: the runaway coins float back into the owner's path and he collects them without jumping as they fly to him; the suitcase-tenant sprints in and a tick-bolt turns him into a neat cyan pixel card that drops into the owner's pocket; the owner never breaks stride, the blaster fires with each obstacle.
beats.first_frame: Owner in full stride at left-centre with blaster raised, three coins ahead of him at head height, the suitcase-tenant entering at far right, blue ground, hearts full.
beats.impact: Each hit is a bright cyan burst with a sharp ascending blip, the win-label supers stack in on each hit; camera keeps pace with the run so nothing pauses.

beats.title: Clearing the lane, part two
beats.feeling: Total control; even the paperwork and the swarm are toys now.
beats.framing: The ledger avalanche falls again and a single tick-bolt freezes the books mid-air and stacks them into one tidy pixel folder that shrinks into the phone in the owner's left hand; the complaint swarm dives and one wide cyan bolt sweeps them, each appliance sprite flipping to a smiling face and lining up in a queue behind him; at frame-right the top of a flagpole comes into view.
beats.first_frame: Owner mid-run at centre, phone in left hand and blaster in right, ledger books starting to fall from the top-right, the appliance swarm entering at the right edge, the tip of a flagpole visible at the far right of the frame.
beats.impact: Two clean shots, two clean resolutions, faster music; the smiling queue behind the owner is the comic hold; the flagpole tip is the promise of the finish.

beats.title: The flag
beats.feeling: Level complete. The owner is finally winning his own game.
beats.framing: The owner leaps onto the flagpole, slides down it and a solid cyan #03FFF1 pixel flag rises to the top; the smiling appliance queue and the collected pixel cards cheer behind him; a short burst of pixel fireworks in cyan and white over the pg_lane.
beats.first_frame: Owner mid-leap toward the flagpole at right-centre, the blank cyan flag at the bottom of the pole, the queue of smiling sprites behind him, evening sky.
beats.impact: Classic level-clear rhythm: leap, slide, flag rises, fanfare sting in the chiptune; the plain cyan flag is left clean so the code pass can composite the wordmark on it for the last half second.

beats.title: Brand close (code-composed)
beats.framing: Solid blue #0038FF full-frame ground, the RentOK wordmark from the supplied asset centred (Rent in white, Ok in cyan #03FFF1), the install call to action stacked beneath it and the URL at the bottom; a tiny pixel owner sprite with the blaster stands on the lower edge as the only illustration.
beats.first_frame: Blue #0038FF frame, wordmark centred, install lines and URL already in place, small pixel owner at bottom-centre.
beats.impact: Hard cut from the fireworks, the chiptune resolves on a single held chord; 1.5 s hold, no motion beyond a two-frame idle bounce on the tiny sprite.

label_verification.why: Names obstacle one the instant the owner bumps it, white pixel-font super in the upper third, so the muted viewer reads the problem

label_rent.why: Names obstacle two on the first missed coin

label_left.why: Names obstacle three on the owner's skid after the runner passes

label_recon.why: Names obstacle four on the paper pile-up freeze

label_complaints.why: Names obstacle five as the swarm circles; fades with the dimming world

cheat_code.why: Typed letter by letter into the pixel input bar as the cheat code, INSTALL on the first line, RENTOK APP on the second; this is the first brand mark and the mechanic that unlocks the power-up

phone_wordmark.why: Supplied rentok_wordmark asset composited onto the phone item's cyan screen (no string, image asset) so the app is a recognisable likeness of the real product

win_kyc.why: Cyan pixel-font super on the shadow-tenant burst: verification solved by digital KYC

win_autopay.why: On the coins flying to the owner: rent collection solved by autopay

win_dues.why: On the suitcase-tenant becoming a card: no more leaving unpaid, dues are tracked live

win_dashboard.why: On the ledgers folding into the phone: reconciliation solved by one dashboard

win_tickets.why: On the swarm turning to smiles: complaints solved by tickets

flag_wordmark.why: Supplied rentok_wordmark asset composited onto the raised cyan flag for the final half second of the level-clear

close_card.why: Brand close: wordmark asset centred on blue #0038FF, INSTALL over RENTOK APP beneath it in white pixel font, RENTOK.COM at the bottom in cyan

mandatory.customer_words: The video has a Mario game ... An original Mario-inspired game, rather than an exact reproduction of Nintendo's character, artwork, music or game assets
mandatory.realisation: An original 2D pixel platformer with its own hero (a moustached PG owner in a kurta), its own obstacles, an original chiptune bed and an Indian PG lane level; the negative line forbids Nintendo characters, mushrooms, question blocks and turtles

mandatory.customer_words: The player is basically a PG owner
mandatory.realisation: The hero sprite is a PG owner: kurta, key ring on his belt, the level is a lane of PG buildings; established in beat 1 and carried through every beat

mandatory.customer_words: The obstacles in the game are basically the problems that owner faces — tenant verification, collecting rent, tenants leaving without paying rent, no place to do reconciliation, solving complaints
mandatory.realisation: Five obstacles, one per beat 2-6: the blank-ID shadow tenant, coins that hop away, the suitcase runner, the ledger avalanche, the angry appliance swarm; each is named with the brief's exact label super

mandatory.customer_words: The game also introduces a cheat code — install RentOK app
mandatory.realisation: Beat 7: a pixel cheat-code input bar where INSTALL / RENTOK APP is typed letter by letter by code; on completion the phone power-up drops in and the owner touches it; the same two strings return as the ask on the close card

mandatory.customer_words: Once it is done, Mario gets a gun sort of power/immunity ... preserving the requested game-style power/immunity mechanic
mandatory.realisation: Beat 8: the owner receives the ok_blaster, a cyan hand blaster firing tick-shaped bolts, plus a cyan outline glow and refilled hearts that signal immunity for the rest of the run

mandatory.customer_words: It runs and kills all the obstacles
mandatory.realisation: Beats 8-10: without breaking stride the owner shoots every one of the five obstacles; each dissolves or converts on one hit, with the matching solved-feature super
Beat 11: level-clear flagpole leap and slide, cyan flag rises with the wordmark composited on it

mandatory.customer_words: Platforms: Instagram Reels / Facebook and YouTube Shorts
mandatory.realisation: 9:16 vertical frame, game world fills the frame, all supers kept inside the upper and middle thirds clear of platform UI, film reads muted
Twelve contiguous beats totalling exactly 30 s

mandatory.customer_words: Brand and product source: Official RentOK website, https://rentok.com ... identity_invariants: Rent in white, Ok in cyan #03FFF1, blue #0038FF ground
mandatory.realisation: Brand blue is the ground the whole game runs on, brand cyan is the power-up and blaster colour; the supplied wordmark asset is composited untouched on the phone screen, the flag and the close card; the URL closes the film

All thirteen distinct strings are composed by code as overlays at the placements listed, never generated inside the imagery; obstacle labels on beats 2-6, cheat code on beat 7, win labels on beats 8-10, ask and URL on beat 12

brand_timeline.in_context: 16.5 s: the RentOK wordmark on the phone power-up's screen inside the game world, then 27.8 s on the level-clear flag; brand blue #0038FF is the ground from 0 s and brand cyan #03FFF1 is the power colour from 15 s

last_frame: Solid blue #0038FF frame, RentOK wordmark centred (Rent white, Ok cyan), INSTALL over RENTOK APP beneath it, RENTOK.COM at the bottom, a tiny pixel owner with the blaster idling at bottom-centre.
